0.text: It’s nearly time. Almost time. About time. You’ve heard his call haven’t you? The call of… wait, I don’t know you.

1.text: Why, you’re not from around here are you? An outsider? By the dead lord! You best not start messing around in our affairs.

2.text: We’ve already got one of you foreign busybodies hangin’ ‘round like a bad smell...

0.text: That prying good-fer-nothing Archaeologist. We’ve chased him off a few times now, but the bastard keeps coming back.

1.text: Pokes around in our ruins, plays with our religious artifacts. He’s engaging in things he can’t possibly comprehend. You best not be like him…
